assets.role: Separate exterior plane; window geometry, lighting, rain, traffic and UI remain live layers.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One production BACKGROUND PLANE for an original cyberpunk repair and secondhand shop game, landscape panoramic composition about 2.2:1. ONLY the exterior street seen straight across from a small ground-floor shop window at eye level. No window frame, no interior, no counter, no UI, no foreground characters or objects. A dense lived-in East Asian port-city service alley after rain at midnight: humble repair kiosks, cable junctions, overhead power conduits, apartment towers layered far above, an elevated transit bridge high in the background. Opposite shop fronts have strongly readable cool cyan and muted ultraviolet light strips, a few compact magenta sign shapes and warm amber work lights; practical ventilation grilles, dark steel shutters and translucent polycarbonate panels. The tech is clearly futuristic but repaired and affordable, with taped conduit, patched steel and small illuminated circuit details. Plenty of architectural silhouettes, no medieval roofs, no steampunk brass, no nostalgic village. The lower quarter is wet dark asphalt with cyan and magenta reflected light, a narrow curb and restrained puddle detail. The central middle third is relatively calm dark shopfront surfaces, leaving visual room for a game character composited later. Highest luminous accents at the far sides and upper shop signs; no giant central billboard. Hand-painted premium game environment illustration, coherent material detail, slightly stylized realism, crisp designed shapes, atmospheric distant depth. Palette petrol blue, graphite, violet and cyan; amber only as a small human warmth accent. Bright and clear enough to read, no crushing black voids, no overpowering bloom, no rainbow saturation. No readable text, logos, watermark, people, falling rain streaks, vehicles, animated effects, or extra frames; the game draws rain, light spill and passing traffic independently. Deliver ONE finished environment plate, not a whole shop screenshot and not a contact sheet.

assets.role: Independent future industrial terminal casing, live accessible business and visitor UI rendered separately.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE finished modular game prop sprite on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. A compact wide industrial information terminal from a working-class cyberpunk repair shop. Dead-on FRONT ORTHOGRAPHIC view, no perspective, no table or scene, complete object with 3 percent transparent margin, landscape silhouette about 1.7:1. Main housing is graphite blue-gray powder-coated steel and reinforced dark polymer, angular chamfered corners, layered replacement panels, tiny fasteners, fine believable scratches, a small amber repair sticker with no words. A single thin cyan status-light strip along the left bezel and subtle violet reflected light from upper right; readable realistic materials, premium hand-painted 2D game concept illustration. The large display is utterly EMPTY, uniform very dark blue teal #0a1c26, no text, no numbers, no waveform, no reflections across the central viewing area. Screen rectangle occupies x 8 to 82 percent and y 13 to 80 percent of the entire object, aligned for live UI text to be composited later. Right 14 percent of terminal contains a vertical vent grille, one small recessed rectangular service port, and a round illuminated pale-green physical pushbutton near the lower right. Very shallow body edge, two short feet. Slim cyan rim illumination on the frame only, no external neon halo. This should feel like affordable repaired future equipment, not a vintage TV, not steampunk: no bronze, no brass, no ornate knobs, no wood. No cables outside silhouette, no cast shadow beyond silhouette, no surrounding objects, no logos, typography or watermark. Only one terminal, not multiple views or a concept sheet.
